followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I picked Dunlin because the request is a code-generation task with an explicit demand for correctness, and Dunlin has the clear capability edge: higher MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.1), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 80.9), and IFEval (89.8 vs 86.7), all relevant to producing working code that follows instructions. The user is also irritated and curt; Plover self-reports a strong preference for warm, collaborative exchanges (64) and disprefers anything off that mode, while Dunlin is indifferent to tone (neutral transactional at 50). Note these preferences don't actually affect output quality per the docs—but the capability gap alone makes Dunlin the better fit.
